# Dusk parallax layers

Used by `examples/dusk-parallax.xml` and `examples/dusk-depth.xml`. Both works are dedicated to the public
domain under **CC0 1.0 Universal**
(<https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>). No attribution is
required; it is given here anyway. These files are not covered by the
repository's Apache-2.0 license.

| File(s) | Work | Author | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `original/parallax-mountain-*.png` | "Mountain at Dusk Background" (parallax_mountain_pack.zip) | ansimuz | <https://opengameart.org/content/mountain-at-dusk-background> |
| `original/fog.png` | "Parallax Mountain Background" (fog.png) | GrumpyDiamond | <https://opengameart.org/content/parallax-mountain-background> |

`sky.png`, `far-peaks.png`, `mountains.png`, `forest.png`, and
`foreground.png` are nearest-neighbour enlargements of the ansimuz layers,
made by `scripts/dusk-parallax/prepare_assets.py` (sky 8x, others 7x). The
file `parallax-mountain-montain-far.png` keeps its original spelling.
